rows.title: Shipping generator; no active work
rows.detail: dharmatiles-gen builds the library tiles from src/tiles/. It stays the shipping code until the Rust cutover (P6).

rows.title: Phase 0 spikes: decided GO (2 Nov 2026)
rows.detail: R1, R2, R3, R6 and R9 passed. Determinism level B chosen, contact sheet approved, no vetoes. Branch rust/p0, revision 8 of the study.

rows.title: Round 17 accepted
rows.detail: Crisp sparse chips, bold column setbacks, closed core holes (31f7c5d on main).

rows.title: Look pages done, audience first
rows.detail: All eight look pages (ground, grass, rocks, cliffs, water, walls, trees, composition) open with the look, its use in a tile and its specification; rulings, requirements, reference photos and history sit lower in a design record. Home and standards pages lead with what a tile user needs.

rows.title: Docs follow-ups done: 55° audits, live doc paths, red-painted renders
rows.detail: rocklab/grasslab/dirtlab audit at 55° (clifflab face report reads the constant); ~40 dead docs/ paths in code repointed; red-overhang heroes on trees, walls and composition; variants page images fixed; 0 broken links.

rows.title: Phase 1 done: flat tile prints from Rust
rows.detail: Merged into main (84056d8). Flat 1×1 DB tile: watertight, 0 overhang, 0.1 s, same hashes on macOS and Linux; review findings fixed; Shawn's test print seated and the contact-sheet layout is approved.

rows.title: Phase 2 started: dirt and hills
rows.detail: Branch rust/p2. Kernels (noise, distance, morphology, blur), operations, the ground and dirt looks ported from dirtlab, soil-1x1.kdl, watch. Ends with Shawn signing off Rust beside dirtlab over seeds 1–4.
